verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at https://www.checkout.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and a second docs-scoped llms.txt at /docs/llms.txt indexes product and API content. The official MCP server also gives agents structured access to the latest API reference, integration guides and support site, which is explicitly pitched as reducing hallucinations. missing for 10: markdown renderings of docs pages (/docs.md returns 404), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed standard paths (all 404), independent corroboration of llms.txt quality or completeness.
